title: The Cold Grill
scene: At 7:40 PM, the campsite food box was raided. Rain kept everyone in their tents from 7:20 to 8:00.

suspects.name: Uma Pike
suspects.testimony: I was in my tent at 7:40, reading by flashlight.
suspects.alibiProof: Uma's tent lamp was on from 7:25, logged by the site meter.

suspects.name: Vince Lund
suspects.testimony: I was in the shelter tent at 7:40, mapping the trail.
suspects.alibiProof: The shelter camera shows Vince's map at 7:38.

suspects.name: Wendy Ash
suspects.testimony: I was in my tent at 7:40, listening to the rain.
suspects.alibiProof: Wendy's tent zipper sensor stayed shut from 7:21 to 7:55.

suspects.name: Xavier Reed
suspects.testimony: I was in the shelter at 7:40, boiling water.
suspects.contradiction: The stove was cold at 7:40, and cracker crumbs led to Xavier's tent.
